LOOP WORKSPACE — DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM
Version 3.1 — Effective 2025-07-15
Retrieved 2026-02-03T09:21:30Z

1. SCOPE
This DPA applies to Loop's processing of Customer Content in the Loop Workspace service.

2. SUBPROCESSORS
2.1 Customer authorizes Loop to engage the Subprocessors listed at loopworkspace.example/subprocessors.
2.2 Loop gives 30 days' notice of new Subprocessors and Customer may object in writing.
2.3 Subprocessors that process Protected Health Information are bound by written agreements no less
    protective than this DPA and, where applicable, by a Business Associate Agreement.

3. AI FEATURES
3.1 "AI Features" means Loop Assist and any successor generative capability.
3.2 Loop does not use Customer Content to train, retrain, or fine-tune generative models.
3.3 Prompts and outputs are retained for thirty (30) days for safety and abuse monitoring and are then
    deleted. Customer may not opt out of abuse-monitoring retention.
3.4 Loop does not publish accuracy, error-rate, or hallucination-rate metrics for AI Features.
3.5 Loop conducts internal adversarial testing of AI Features. Results are not shared with customers.

4. SECURITY
4.1 Loop maintains an information security program aligned to ISO/IEC 27001.
4.2 Breach notification within 72 hours of confirmation.

5. HEALTHCARE
5.1 The Loop BAA is available to Enterprise Grid customers and covers Customer Content processed by
    the Services, including AI Features, and by Subprocessors marked as BAA-covered.

6. DELETION
6.1 Customer Content is deleted within 30 days of workspace termination.
